title: 第二十五章 小蝴蝶第二十六章 咱有钱
lines: 第二十五章：小蝴蝶
从楚静瑶的房间里出来，林昆头也不回的钻进了卫生间，关上门拧开水龙头，凉水哗哗的流了出来，他把头整个伸到下面，任凭凉水冲过。
几分钟后，他站了起来，看着镜子里湿漉漉的自己，长舒一口气，现在感觉好多了，心跳不那么剧烈了，脸颊也不那么烫了，呼吸也平稳了。
戏是假的，可他身体里的反应是真的，他一个在漠北憋了好几年的大男人，突然间压在楚静瑶这么一个女神级别的尤物身上，体内的肾上腺素猛然间仿佛化成了无坚不摧的野兽在他体内横冲直撞，也就是他这个意志如铁的男人把持的住，换做普通的男人，刚才肯定趁机把楚静瑶给……
拽了条毛巾擦了把脸，林昆从卫生间里出来了，小楚澄这时坐在楚静瑶的床上，把他小书包里的东西都倒了出来，翻出这样那样的故事书让楚静瑶给他读，看到林昆后，小家伙马上冲他招呼道：“爸爸，快过来！”
林昆笑了笑，眼神悄然的看向楚静瑶，楚静瑶低着头在帮小楚澄整理书本，脸上的表情看不到，她现在一定不待见自己吧，想着林昆就对小楚澄说道：“澄澄，你先跟你妈妈玩吧，爸爸要下去给你们做晚餐了。”
“爸爸，我要吃西红柿炒鸡蛋！”小家伙又转过头问楚静瑶，道：“妈妈，你吃什么？”
楚静瑶冲小楚澄笑笑，道：“妈妈随便。”眼神却一点也不往林昆这边看。
小楚澄道：“不行，随便怎么行呢，要不我帮妈妈想一个菜吧，就吃红烧排骨吧！”
楚静瑶笑着点点头，“好吧。”
小楚澄看向林昆，笑着道：“爸爸，我吃西红柿炒鸡蛋，妈妈吃红烧排骨！”
林昆嘴角一笑，故意拿捏腔调，道：“好嘞，二位客官请稍等，饭菜马上就上来！今天本店店庆，再免费送二位客官一个西红柿牛腩汤！”
“好棒哦！”
小楚澄开心的叫道，楚静瑶却是一副不为所动的表情，低着头继续帮儿子整理书本，林昆向她看过来，她也像是完全感觉不到似的，林昆苦笑一下，转身下楼，这时她的嘴角才轻轻的露出一个微笑。
厨房里食材齐全，林昆只稍微的施展了一下他的厨艺，就做出了两菜一汤，主食是红豆米饭，额外放了点黑芝麻和香米，一开锅那香味叫个诱人。
楚静瑶脚扭了不方便下楼，林昆就把饭菜端到了楼上，摆在二楼客厅的茶几上，然后就喊母子俩出来吃饭。
小楚澄扶着楚静瑶一瘸一拐的出来，却不见林昆的踪影，小家伙跑到楼梯口，冲楼下喊道：“爸爸，你在干什么，怎么不上来和澄澄一起吃饭呀！”
楼下传来了林昆的声音，“儿子，你和你妈妈先吃，爸爸忙完了就上来。”
小家伙哦了一声，回到茶几旁边，桌子上的饭已经盛好了，筷子也摆好了，香喷喷的米饭和菜香马上就引诱的小家伙直流口水，小家伙端起饭碗扒拉了一口，然后鼓着腮帮子冲楚静瑶道：“妈妈，爸爸做的饭好好吃哦，你快尝尝！”
楚静瑶吃了一口，笑着冲儿子点点头，“澄澄，喜欢吃就多吃点。”
“嗯。”小楚澄点点头，大口的吃了起来。
大约过了十多分钟，娘俩已经吃的差不多了，楚静瑶晚上的饭量很小，几乎是吃一点就饱了，小楚澄则是遇到了好吃的就风卷残云，很快就把小肚子填的差不多了。
这时，林昆端着一个西方用的餐盘从楼下上来，餐盘的上面盖着个盖子，看上去还挺神秘的，小楚澄马上就问道：“爸爸，你端的什么呀！”
林昆神秘的道：“秘密。”
小楚澄哦了一声，小眼睛里充满了好奇，跑过来围着餐盘来回的看。
林昆把餐盘放到了楚静瑶的面前，楚静瑶还是一副不搭理他的表情，对于他和餐盘都看也不看，一点好奇心都没有，林昆自己干笑了两声，冲小楚澄问道：“儿子，想不想知道这里面装的是什么好东东呀？”
小楚澄马上说道：“想！”
林昆说：“这东东可好吃着呢，最适合饭后吃了，而且心情不好的时候吃起来，也有一定的疗效，只可惜一些害怕自己胖的人不敢吃……”
楚静瑶站起来，准备回房间。
林昆赶紧拦在她身前，嬉皮笑脸的道：“这位美女，请听我把话说完。”
“让开。”楚静瑶冷着脸道，她又不是小孩子，林昆说了那么多，她当然知道里面放的是什么，尤其听到林昆说到‘胖’字的时候，她就更听不下去了。
林昆冲小楚澄递了个眼神，小家伙马上会意，站到楚静瑶的身边，拉着楚静瑶的胳膊摇晃道：“妈妈，你就听爸爸说完吧，澄澄想知道里面的是什么东西。”
楚静瑶看着儿子直接道出答案：“澄澄，里面是甜品，你以前吃过的。”
小楚澄仰起好奇的笑脸，看着林昆道：“爸爸，是甜品么？”
林昆笑着点点头，“不过，你妈妈只说对了一半。”

Chapter 25: Little Butterfly
After coming out of Chu Jingyao's room, Lin Kun went into the bathroom without looking back, closed the door and turned on the faucet. Cold water flowed out. He stretched his head underneath and let the cold water rush through.
A few minutes later, he stood up, looked at himself wet in the mirror, and breathed a long sigh of relief. He felt better now, his heartbeat was not so violent, his cheeks were not so hot, and his breathing was calmer.
The play was fake, but the reaction in his body was real. He, a big man who had been holding back in Mobei for several years, suddenly fell on Chu Jingyao, a goddess-level beauty. The adrenaline in his body suddenly seemed to turn into an indestructible beast rampaging through his body. That is, he, a man with an iron will, could control it. If it were an ordinary man, he would have taken the opportunity to kill Chu Jingyao just now...
Pulling a towel and wiping his face, Lin Kun came out of the bathroom. At this time, little Chu Cheng sat on Chu Jingyao's bed, emptied everything out of his little schoolbag, and took out one or another storybook for Chu Jingyao to read to him. After seeing Lin Kun, the little guy immediately greeted him: "Dad, come here!"
Lin Kun smiled and looked quietly at Chu Jingyao. Chu Jingyao lowered her head and was helping little Chu Cheng organize the books. The expression on her face was invisible. She must not want to see him now. Thinking of Lin Kun, he said to little Chu Cheng: "Chengcheng, you can play with your mother first. Dad is going down to make dinner for you."
"Dad, I want to eat tomatoes and scrambled eggs!" The little guy turned around and asked Chu Jingyao, "Mom, what do you eat?"
Chu Jingyao smiled at little Chu Cheng and said, "Mom, whatever." But she didn't look at Lin Kun at all.
Xiao Chucheng said: "No, you can do whatever you want. How about I help mom think of a dish, let's eat braised pork ribs!"
Chu Jingyao smiled and nodded, "Okay."
Xiao Chucheng looked at Lin Kun and said with a smile: "Dad, I eat scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and mom eats braised pork ribs!"
Lin Kun smiled at the corner of his mouth and said in a deliberate tone: "Okay, you two guests, please wait a moment, the food will be here soon! Today is our store's celebration, and we will give you two guests a tomato and beef brisket soup for free!"
"That's great!"
Xiao Chucheng shouted happily, but Chu Jingyao had an unmoved expression, lowering her head and continuing to help her son organize the books. Lin Kun looked over at her, and she seemed not to feel it at all. Lin Kun smiled bitterly, turned around and went downstairs, and then a smile appeared on the corner of her mouth.
There were all the ingredients in the kitchen. Lin Kun only showed off his cooking skills a little and made two dishes and one soup. The staple food was red beans and rice, with some extra black sesame and fragrant rice. The aroma when the pot was opened was very tempting.
Chu Jingyao sprained her leg and couldn't go downstairs, so Lin Kun brought the food upstairs, placed it on the coffee table in the living room on the second floor, and then called mother and son out to eat.
Little Chu Cheng helped Chu Jingyao limp out, but Lin Kun was nowhere to be seen. The little guy ran to the stairs and shouted downstairs: "Dad, what are you doing? Why don't you come up and eat with Cheng Cheng!"
Lin Kun's voice came from downstairs, "Son, you and your mother eat first. Dad will come up when he's done."
The little guy yelled, and returned to the coffee table. The rice on the table had been served, and the chopsticks were placed. The fragrant rice and vegetable aroma immediately made the little guy drool. The little guy picked up the rice bowl and took a bite. Then he puffed up his cheeks and said to Chu Jingyao: "Mom, the rice cooked by dad is delicious. Try it quickly!"
Chu Jingyao took a bite, smiled and nodded to her son, "Chengcheng, eat more if you like."
"Yeah." Xiao Chucheng nodded and started eating.
About ten minutes later, the two of them had almost eaten. Chu Jingyao's meal at night was very small, and she was almost full after just a small amount. Little Chu Cheng, on the other hand, was in a hurry when she encountered delicious food, and her belly was almost full in no time.
At this time, Lin Kun came up from downstairs carrying a Western dinner plate with a lid on it. It looked quite mysterious. Little Chu Cheng immediately asked: "Dad, what are you serving!"
Lin Kun said mysteriously: "Secret."
Xiao Chucheng said oh, her little eyes full of curiosity, and ran over to look back and forth around the dinner plate.
Lin Kun put the dinner plate in front of Chu Jingyao, but Chu Jingyao still ignored him. She didn't even look at him or the dinner plate, and had no curiosity at all. Lin Kun laughed twice and asked little Chu Cheng: "Son, do you want to know what good stuff is in this?"
Xiao Chucheng immediately said: "I want to!"
Lin Kun said: "This stuff is delicious. It is best eaten after meals, and it also has certain curative effects when you are in a bad mood. It's a pity that some people who are afraid of getting fat don't dare to eat it..."
Chu Jingyao stood up and prepared to go back to the room.
Lin Kun quickly stopped in front of her and said with a playful smile: "Beauty, please listen to what I have to say."
"Get out of the way." Chu Jingyao said with a cold face. She was not a child. Lin Kun had said so much, so of course she knew what was inside. Especially when she heard Lin Kun say the word "fat", she couldn't stand listening anymore.
Lin Kun glanced at little Chu Cheng. The little guy immediately understood. He stood next to Chu Jingyao, took Chu Jingyao's arm and shook it: "Mom, just listen to what dad has to say. Chengcheng wants to know what's inside."
Chu Jingyao looked at her son and answered directly: "Chengcheng, there are desserts inside, which you have eaten before."
Little Chu Cheng raised a curious smile, looked at Lin Kun and said, "Dad, is it dessert?"
Lin Kun smiled and nodded, "However, your mother is only half right."
